# SafeToL2Migration

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/b791ffd0a9860e205e9b54711c9aea03c227481f/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/SafeToL2Migration.sol)

**Inherits:** [SafeStorage](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/contract.SafeStorage)

**Title:** Migration Contract for updating a Safe from 1.1.1/1.3.0/1.4.1 versions to a L2 version. Useful when replaying a Safe from a non L2 network in a L2 network.

This contract facilitates the migration of a Safe contract from version 1.1.1 to 1.3.0/1.4.1 L2, 1.3.0 to 1.3.0L2 or from 1.4.1 to 1.4.1L2
        Other versions are not supported

<i>

IMPORTANT: The migration will only work with proxies that store the implementation address in the storage slot 0.

</i>

## Constants

### MIGRATION_SINGLETON

```solidity
address public immutable MIGRATION_SINGLETON;
```

### constructor

Initializes the migrationSingleton with the contract's own address.

</i>

```solidity
constructor();
```

<a id="onlydelegatecall"></a>

### onlyDelegateCall

Modifier to make a function callable via delegatecall only.
If the function is called via a regular call, it will revert.

```solidity
modifier onlyDelegateCall();
```

<a id="onlynoncezero"></a>

### onlyNonceZero

Modifier to prevent using initialized Safes.
If Safe has a nonce higher than 0, it will revert

```solidity
modifier onlyNonceZero();
```

<a id="migrate-address-bytes"></a>

### migrate

<i>

Internal function with common migration steps, changes the singleton and emits SafeMultiSigTransaction event

</i>

```solidity
function migrate(address l2Singleton, bytes memory functionData) private;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| l2Singleton | `address` |  |
| functionData | `bytes` |  |

<a id="migratetol2-address"></a>

### migrateToL2

Migrate from Safe 1.3.0/1.4.1 Singleton (L1) to the same version provided L2 singleton
Safe is required to have nonce 0 so backend can support it after the migration

<i>

This function should only be called via a delegatecall to perform the upgrade.
Singletons versions will be compared, so it implies that contracts exist

</i>

```solidity
function migrateToL2(address l2Singleton) external onlyDelegateCall onlyNonceZero;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| l2Singleton | `address` |  |

<a id="migratefromv111-address-address"></a>

### migrateFromV111

Migrate from Safe 1.1.1 Singleton to 1.3.0 or 1.4.1 L2
Safe is required to have nonce 0 so backend can support it after the migration

<i>

This function should only be called via a delegatecall to perform the upgrade.
Singletons version will be checked, so it implies that contracts exist.
A valid and compatible fallbackHandler needs to be provided, only existence will be checked.

</i>

```solidity
function migrateFromV111(address l2Singleton, address fallbackHandler) external onlyDelegateCall onlyNonceZero;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| l2Singleton | `address` |  |
| fallbackHandler | `address` |  |

<a id="iscontract-address"></a>

### isContract

Checks whether an Ethereum address corresponds to a contract or an externally owned account (EOA).

<i>

This function relies on the `extcodesize` assembly opcode to determine whether an address is a contract.
It may return incorrect results in some edge cases (see documentation for details).
Developers should use caution when relying on the results of this function for critical decision-making.

</i>

```solidity
function isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| account | `address` | The Ethereum address to be checked. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bool` | A boolean value indicating whether the address is associated with a contract (true) or an EOA (false). |

<a id="getowners"></a>

### getOwners

Returns a list of Safe owners.

<i>

This function is copied from `OwnerManager.sol` and takes advantage of the fact that
migration happens with a `DELEGATECALL` in the context of the migrating account, which allows
us to read the owners directly from storage and avoid the additional overhead of a `CALL`
into the account implementation. Note that we can rely on the memory layout of the [owners](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/contract.SafeStorage#owners)

</i>

```solidity
function getOwners() internal view returns (address[] memory);
```

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `address[]` | Array of Safe owners. |

### SafeMultiSigTransaction

```solidity
event SafeMultiSigTransaction(
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        bytes data,
        Enum.Operation operation,
        uint256 safeTxGas,
        uint256 baseGas,
        uint256 gasPrice,
        address gasToken,
        address payable refundReceiver,
        bytes signatures,
        // We combine nonce, sender and threshold into one to avoid stack too deep
        // Dev note: additionalInfo should not contain `bytes`, as this complicates decoding
        bytes additionalInfo
    );
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| to | `address` |  |
